scope: Read-only source/patch review; no CLI or paid invocation; owner red/green logs not independently rerun.
invariants: Live compaction_start/end emits one existing parse_error usage gap immediately, while known assistant generation usage remains unchanged.
Aggregate compaction usage is never emitted as a response generation or invented response ID.
No change to complete flag, native final collector or delivery acceptance; accounting gap does not suppress otherwise valid business final.
Session suffix fallback occurs after file identity and inspectPiTurn prefix/current-branch/session/input checks; only new suffix compaction rows inspected.
Historical compaction rows in resumed session cannot contaminate current Run usage.
Tests cover start/end/start-only/end-only/suffix-only, existing known amount, final proof and ACK evidence, resumed clean turn, and gap delivery before process kill.
limits: A compaction start may precede model request or extension cancellation. Gap denotes unproven coverage, never proof of additional billed generation.
No recovery of aggregate compaction totals into canonical per-response ledger; observed sums remain partial.
Hard kill before any observable event still cannot reveal unreported work.
